Can you provide a example(s) of configurations using the newly added properties.

Seen your stacked change https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/entity-manager/+/86157/3

but it does not require `PLDMSensors` property. So i am wondering why we are adding it if there is no config which needs that change.
Done

Let's make `Inventory` a required property to align with DBus design guidelines.

We can just leave it empty in case there is no inventory name.
Inventory name is not necessary. If we don’t add it, the system will use the terminus name as the inventory name in PLDMD.

> If we don’t add it, the system will use the terminus name as the inventory name in PLDMD.

I'm aware that it would work as an optional property.

I'm more concerned about the DBus API. DBus interfaces do not have optional properties. Because EM directly creates DBus interfaces from config json, we cannot have optional properties in configuration schemas (without breaking DBus design intent)

(referring to https://dbus.freedesktop.org/doc/dbus-api-design.html)
Done.

Let's make `Inventory` a required property to align with DBus design guidelines.

We can just leave it empty in case there is no inventory name.
Done
just curious, what do you mean by override? These PLDM sensors were already found elsewhere but just didn't have a real name?

Some devices do not support auxiliary names such as OCP NIC. In this case, Pldmd will use the combination of terminus number and sensor ID as the sensor name. Currently, we can use the target name as an auxiliary name, but there is no support to replace the sensor ID with a name.

We want to rename the sensors as follows:

From Terminus_1_Sensor_300 to NIC_TEMPERATURE1
From Terminus_1_Sensor_500 to NIC_TEMPERATURE2
Acknowledged
How is this different than "Name"?

This change ensures that the inventory is not tied to the target name.
pldmd uses the target name as the inventory name and also uses the target name as a prefix for sensor names.
Do you have an example of something pushed to Gerrit which explains why the "Name" and "Inventory" need to be different?
